  20260909-141956-d-tac-j6z tactical directive decision [confidence: high] (Felix) {status: settled} <area-graph-reading, architecture> Every entry record returned by `Entries()` carries its declared links directly on the record: `Refs` exposes each relation's identifier, kind, and description sentence; `Closes` and `Supersedes` expose the corresponding identifiers; all three fields are present even when empty. A dangling link naming an absent entry is silently dropped; malformed link mappings are skipped individually without discarding the rest.
